content.text: Hold ENTER to reel  B back

scripts.init: local v = ctx.v; v.tension = 50; v.progress = 0; v.fish_pull = 0; v.tension_text = 'OK'; v.state = 'fishing'; v.timer = 0;
scripts.update: local v = ctx.v; if v.state ~= 'fishing' then return end; local dt = time.dt; v.timer = v.timer + dt; if v.timer > 1.0 then v.fish_pull = math.random(-20, 30); v.timer = 0 end; local input_pull = 0; if _G.love.keyboard.isDown('return') then input_pull = 25 end; v.tension = v.tension + (v.fish_pull + input_pull) * dt; if v.tension < 0 then v.tension = 0 elseif v.tension > 100 then v.tension = 100 end; if v.tension > 20 and v.tension < 80 then v.progress = v.progress + 10 * dt else v.progress = v.progress - 5 * dt end; if v.progress < 0 then v.progress = 0 elseif v.progress >= 100 then v.progress = 100; v.state = 'caught'; v.tension_text = 'CAUGHT!' return end; if v.tension >= 100 then v.state = 'snapped'; v.tension_text = 'LINE SNAPPED!' return end; if v.tension <= 0 then v.state = 'escaped'; v.tension_text = 'FISH ESCAPED!' return end;
